acceptance.given: A rebuilt Exact Cover validation input enumerates every active atomic obligation and its required witness mappings.

oracle.expected: Validation reports required witnesses for 100% of atomic obligations with zero missing witness links.
forbidden: Any atomic obligation lacks a required witness.
Required witness coverage is incomplete for any atomic obligation.
oracle.observable: The Exact Cover validator output contains a complete bidirectional obligation-to-witness mapping and zero orphan obligations.

acceptance.then: The validation artifact records a required witness for every atomic obligation and no orphan obligation remains.
acceptance.when: The Exact Cover and witness validator executes against the frozen obligation register.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove one required witness mapping from the frozen Exact Cover input and verify the validator rejects incomplete coverage.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce complete witness coverage for every atomic obligation and reject orphan or missing witness mappings.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay and Exact Cover schemas; rollback restores prior witness-validation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unvalidated atomic witness coverage -> validated complete bidirectional coverage or deterministic rejection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Exact Cover validation terminates unsuccessfully whenever any atomic obligation is missing a required witness; otherwise it reports 100% witness coverage.

acceptance.given: A repository-contained target package is supplied for validation or use.

oracle.expected: A distinct verification result establishes the target package identity before acceptance or use.
forbidden: Accepting or using a target package whose identity was not independently verified.
oracle.observable: The toolchain emits an independently computed target-identity verification artifact tied to the effective inspected package.

acceptance.then: The independently verified identity is bound to the package actually inspected, and only then may downstream processing proceed.
acceptance.when: Target identity verification runs before any target package is accepted or consumed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Substitute a target package after identity calculation or omit the independent verification result; the acceptance path must fail closed.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Independently recompute and bind target package identity to the effective inspected package before acceptance or use.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Maintain backward-compatible target validation interfaces and receipt fields.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unverified target input -> independently verified identity bound to effective target, or fail-closed rejection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: No target package is accepted or used unless an independent identity verification artifact matches the package actually inspected.

acceptance.given: A foreign-authority case is presented to the success evaluator.

oracle.expected: The case receives a non-success result and success is rejected.
forbidden: Success is accepted for a foreign-authority case.
oracle.observable: The evaluator's terminal result for the foreign-authority case is a non-success category such as identity-invalid, evidence-invalid, or comparison-failed.

acceptance.then: The evaluator refuses to publish or return success for the foreign-authority case.
acceptance.when: Success evaluation processes the case and checks lifecycle authority and evidence bindings.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Inject a foreign lifecycle authorization into the evaluated case and verify terminal success is rejected.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject success whenever evaluated evidence carries foreign lifecycle authority or otherwise violates non-authorizing replay contracts.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve non-authorizing receipt compatibility and existing terminal categories.

slice_hint.state_transition: Foreign-authority evidence presented -> deterministic non-success terminal result; success publication remains blocked.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Any foreign-authority case evaluates to a non-success terminal category and cannot be accepted as successful.

acceptance.given: A prior replay result is bound to a Current Snapshot containing result-determining inputs.

oracle.expected: Mutating any bound snapshot member causes deterministic stale or fail-closed status before semantic reproduction is accepted.
forbidden: Changed bound inputs are silently normalized away without an approved versioned policy.
A stale result is reported as reproduced or successful.
oracle.observable: Fresh reconstruction compares bound identities and emits stale/fail-closed status when any result-determining member differs.

acceptance.then: The prior result is invalidated, semantic reproduction is refused, and no stale result is reported as reproduced or successful.
acceptance.when: Verification first reconstructs the original binding identity, then performs fresh replay with that same identity; any changed snapshot input is checked before accepting reproduction.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Mutate one result-determining snapshot member between capture and replay and verify deterministic stale/fail-closed rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Rebuild the original binding identity before replay, replay with that same identity, and reject identity mismatch or unexplained bound-input drift as stale.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve snapshot schema and terminal stale category; prior results remain readable but cannot be reclassified as reproduced after drift.

slice_hint.state_transition: Snapshot-bound prior result -> identity reconstruction and same-identity replay; any changed input -> stale/fail-closed terminal state.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Reproduction is accepted only when reconstructed identities exactly match the original binding; any mismatch deterministically yields stale or another unsuccessful terminal status.
